name: Subaru XV 2.0D (EE20 boxer diesel, 6MT, 2012–2017)
source: Subaru UK EE20 diesel schedule (12 months / 12,500 mi basis), summarised. Check against the service book.

items.name: Engine oil & filter
items.notes: Low-SAPS C3 0W-30/5W-30 because of the DPF.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes, tyres, steering, suspension bushes, CV boots, leaks, battery)
items.notes: Watch the anti-roll bar and front arm rear bushes: they were MOT advisories in 2023–24.

items.name: Fuel filter (drain water trap each service)
Gearbox & front/rear differential oil
items.notes: Subaru: inspect every service, replace under severe use (towing, short trips, off-road). 4x4 so there are three oils.

items.name: Coolant (Subaru Super Coolant)
items.notes: First change at 11 years / 137,500 mi, then every 6 years / 75,000 mi.

items.name: Timing chain & tensioner (inspect)
items.notes: EE20 has a chain, not a belt. Listen for rattle on a cold start.

items.name: DPF health / forced regen check
items.notes: Mostly short trips? Ask for a DPF soot-load check.
